panels.prompt: Medium shot: young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back sits legs folded in narrow niche behind salt-block altar, eyes closed, hands on knees, empty dented tin flask beside him. Warm candle dusk.

Medium shot: young chinese woman, long black braid, dark-blue outfit, glowing white bow stands over a niche, four small bronze flame-shaped tokens on cords in her open palm, reading them. Amber candlelight, salt walls.

Two-shot, candle between them: young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back, quiet; young chinese woman, long black braid, dark-blue outfit, glowing white bow, holding tokens, watching him. Warm amber dusk.

texts.text: Тогда я буду помнить. За обоих.

panels.prompt: Action shot: young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back punches gaunt knight, milky salt-crusted eyes, white-crimson surcoat with flame emblem, bronze censer in the jaw mid-run, dark descending passage, motion lines. Cold blue-black.

Medium shot: gaunt knight, milky salt-crusted eyes, white-crimson surcoat with flame emblem, bronze censer, unconscious, rope-tied at foot of salt altar; balding broad knight-monk, grey surcoat over plate, kite shield sits beside him, gentle. Candlelight.

texts.text: Я останусь с ним, брат. И с ними.

panels.prompt: Wide shot: young witcher man, short ash-grey hair, golden cat eyes, half-asian face, stubble, dark leather armor, two swords on back at dark passage mouth, looking back over shoulder; with black-haired teen with glowing sword, blonde-braided axe woman, black-braided archer with glowing white bow. Torchlight.

texts.text: Один в склепе — это гордыня, Жнец. Идём.
